explore.title: Explore Frequencies
explore.binauralDescription: Binaural beats work by playing slightly different frequencies in each ear. Your brain perceives a third tone at the difference frequency.
explore.solfeggioDescription: Solfeggio frequencies are tones traditionally associated with relaxation and spiritual harmony. Effects are personal; no medical benefit is claimed or scientifically proven.
explore.noiseDescription: Background noise can help mask distracting sounds and improve focus or sleep quality.
explore.solfeggioDisclaimer: A traditional tone. Effects are personal; no medical benefit is claimed.

mixer.description: Create your custom mix by combining multiple sounds. Save it for quick access later.
mixer.maxChannelsDesc: You can only have 4 channels in a mix.
mixer.enterName: Please enter a name for your mix.
mixer.addSoundFirst: Add at least one sound to save a mix.
mixer.emptyDesc: Layer multiple sounds: rain + brown noise + alpha, for example.
mixer.channelsFull: 4 of 4 — remove one to add another

settings.title: Settings
settings.epilepsyText: This app may contain visual effects. Use with caution if you have epilepsy.
settings.lowContrastHint: Eases the harshness between text and background. Not used in night mode.
settings.reduceMotionHint: Stops the breathing ring and screen transitions.
settings.hapticsHint: A light tap for touch feedback.
settings.resetConfirm: Favourites, mixes and all settings will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

intents.sleepDesc: Sounds that help you drift into deep sleep
intents.relaxDesc: Nature sounds and soft tones to unwind
intents.meditateDesc: Deep, calm tones for turning inward

onboarding.step1Desc: Sleep, focus, and relax with binaural beats, pure tones, and ambient sounds.
onboarding.step2Desc: Binaural beats send a different frequency to each ear; headphones are required to hear the effect.
onboarding.step3Desc: Keep the volume at a comfortable level and take breaks if you feel discomfort. This app is not a medical product.
